metadata.description: Real-time 3D pixel-art voxel renderers on two tracks: articulated T3 OBB raymarching + large-scale megastructure meshes (offline 3-view hull or opt-in 3D mesh input with pluggable providers; quad16, packed20, Multi-Cue & Hull-Only G5).

plugins.name: hybrid-voxel-sprite
plugins.description: Agent skill for real-time 3D voxel renderers on two tracks: Track A articulated voxel sprites (T3 OBB raymarching, analytic inverse deform + springs, SVOX CLI, 4 verified engine adapters) and Track B large-scale megastructures (~500-1500 u) in two user-selected modes: B1 offline 3-view visual hull (default) or B2 opt-in 3D .glb/.gltf mesh-to-voxel with pluggable model providers (local, command, manual, optional API adapter). quad16 16 B/quad macro, packed20 meso prefabs, structure-aware ink, 12 MiB budget, Multi-Cue & Hull-Only G5 and G6 gates, zero-dependency Node kit (78/78 + 32/32).
